aloofcardinal: Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina reported to R-R7 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
coleharrison1210: Valentin Coleharrison found a place in S-C12 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
lezu_hans: On Day 6, Jakub Hans arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Hans stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Jakub Hans repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at R-S9 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Jakub Hans's bunk. He has named it Captain.
Captain the rat now waits for Jakub Hans at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Captain ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Jakub Hans followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Captain his life.
obreezyz1: Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz, a brewer from Oakmere, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F8. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
swan.72041943: "You're late," said the corporal when Ulrich "Bones" Swan arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
tsepnidiss._6: Norbert Tsepnidiss, a dance-hall violinist from Halden, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
wanter_cz: The old hands of R-F19 have been here since Day 1. Clement Wanter has been here since Day 3. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Hugo Serreno and Clement Wanter argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Dawn watch. Clement Wanter put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub Nistico, grazed.

Clement Wanter tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. Clement Wanter walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
A bullet went through Clement Wanter's sleeve at R-F19 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Wendel Yaboyslydude of the Concord (@yaboyslydude).
Clement Wanter's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Clement Wanter was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss was grazed.
A muddy dog crawled into R-F19 through the wire. Clement Wanter gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit.
xmrmememanx: Day 9. The corporal put Marek Xmrmememanx beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
